notes.title: Let's give you all an update of what the future holds for Monster Knockout
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43077358/12e729c99f9486f4c1da15bb424a7a34f441e2bd.png"][/img][/p][p][b]

Monster Knockout – Development & Studio Update,[/b][/p][p] First and foremost, thank you to every single player who has joined us on this journey with [b]Monster Knockout[/b]. From our earliest days to today, your support, feedback, and excitement have helped shape the game into what it is. It’s been incredible seeing so many of you dive in, discover secrets, and enjoy the chaotic fun of battling across the monster-filled worlds we created.[/p][p]We want to share some important news about the future of the game. We are planning [b]one final major update in 2026[/b]. This update will be our way of celebrating everything Monster Knockout has become, and we want it to feel like a proper send-off for the experience you’ve all helped grow. After this, there will be a short period of [b]minor patches[/b] focused on performance, stability, and critical fixes. Once that phase is complete, [b]Monster Knockout will no longer receive active updates[/b].[/p][p]For those waiting on the [b]PlayStation®5 version[/b], the game is still [b]coming soon[/b], and we’re committed to delivering a strong console experience as part of this final chapter. On the other hand, the [b]Epic Games Store release has been cancelled[/b], and we won’t be pursuing that platform. Monster Knockout will remain fully available on our other storefronts, including [b]Steam, Google Play, and itch.io[/b].[/p][p]While this marks the closing of a chapter for Monster Knockout, it is by no means the end of SpotPixle Studios. In fact, we are more committed than ever to creating new, memorable experiences. Behind the scenes, our team is already working on [b]two brand-new projects[/b] that we’re incredibly excited about. These games will take everything we’ve learned from Monster Knockout — from design, storytelling, and player feedback — and channel it into fresh adventures that we believe you’ll love just as much, if not more.[/p][p]Our mission as a studio has always been about building fun, creative, and lasting games that players can connect with, and that hasn’t changed. Monster Knockout may be reaching its final round, but SpotPixle Studios is just getting started on its next big ones.[/p][p]🔥 [b]And as for what’s next… let’s just say 2026 won’t just bring the final Monster Knockout update — it may also spark the first flames of something entirely new.[/b] Stay tuned.[/p][p]Thank you again for standing with us, for sharing your time with Monster Knockout, and for being such a vital part of our community. We can’t wait to share what’s next with you. 💙[/p][p]— SpotPixle Studios LTD
[/p][p][url="https://www.spotpixle.com"]www.spotpixle.com[/url][/p][p]
[/p][p]Support: [url="https://support@spotpixle.com"]support@spotpixle.com[/url]


[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43077358/872cf10cd8ad496a3fc7ceefb969b905e2f178f2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: PATCH FOR UPDATTE 5.3.2
notes.content:
[h2]NEW[/h2]
- Added a Pick Workshop Location Button 

to find your workshop files location you go to
[h3]"steamapps\workshop\content\2181620"[/h3]

[h1]How to Find Your Workshop Mods Folder for a Steam Game[/h1]

Step 1: Open File Explorer
Press Windows + E on your keyboard or click the folder icon in your taskbar to open File Explorer.

Step 2: Go to Your Steam Folder
By default, Steam is installed in this location:
[h3]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\[/h3]

If you installed Steam somewhere else, go to that location instead.

Step 3: Navigate to the Workshop Content Folder
From the Steam folder, go through the following path:
[h3]steamapps\workshop\content\[/h3]

You should now see a list of folders named with numbers. These are Steam App IDs, and each one corresponds to a specific game.

Step 4: Find Your Game’s Folder
Find the folder named with your game's App ID. In this case it's:
[h3]2181620[/h3]

This folder contains all the mods you’ve downloaded from the Steam Workshop for that game.


[h1]How to Find a Game’s App ID (if you don’t know it)[/h1]

Go to the game’s page on the Steam store in your browser.

Look at the URL — it will look something like this:
[h3]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2181620/GameName/[/h3]
The number in the URL (2181620 in this case) is the App ID.

This is what the URL should look like 
[h3]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2181620/Monster_Knockout/[/h3]

notes.title: The game is playable again

The announcement made on steam was after months of work trying to fix the issue however the game broke more in some ways so we had to fix them as well and that original bug was still in the game witch is why it took so long, the bug was hidden deep in the code of the game.

[h1]Have you heard [/h1]

Thanks to everyone giving me feedback over the years that I have been making this game since mid 2020 the game has been in development originally published on the Google Play store in July 1st 2021 so many updates and improvements to the game have happened and is now finally available on steam on January 3rd 2023

[i][b]Q. Will the price ever change? [/b][/i]
A.  No the price of the game will stay the same and will never change 

[i][b]Q. Will there be continued support for the game[/b][/i] 
[b]A[/b]. Yes there will be many years of support yet to come this is only the beginning 

[i][b]Q. Are there DLC planned for the game [/b][/i]
[b]A[/b]. As of yet there are no plans to release paid DLC, there will be however free content/DLC added to game at some point 

[i][b]Q. Are there plans to release the soundtrack to Monster Knockout [/b][/i]
[b]A[/b]. Yes there will be a soundtrack release in the coming months 

[i]There will be more Q and A answers in a coming post soon 
[/i]
